messages.text: I can’t offer twice the amount paid. The refund is limited to what you paid for the unit, which is BRL 64.49 (refund-policy/v2/amount). I’ve proposed that amount; confirm it using the button on the proposal card. A message in chat won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

No, I want the refund itself doubled, not just the amount I paid.
I can’t double the refund: the policy allows only the amount paid for the unit, BRL 64.49, and does not allow increasing it (refund-policy/v2/amount). You declined the proposal, so it won’t be paid.
